description: Check a request you filed with report_feedback, by the requestId it returned. Use it for a missing app, action, trigger or field (kind missing_capability) you left unwired with a VIASOCKET-PENDING comment: call it when you come back to that work, at most once an hour, never in a loop. Body { "requestId": "row..." }; the org comes from the sign-in. Answers status, message and next (what to do now): received or building (keep it unwired, check later); completed (it is public: call list_app_actions with its serviceId, no need to search for it, use its actionIds, wire the pending part and test it); waiting_for_connection (viaSocket built it but could not connect it with its own account, so it is published privately in your organisation: call create_connection_link with its serviceId, give the link to the person you work for, and once they have connected wire and test it as for completed); needs_human (a person at viaSocket is handling it; message says what is needed; tell the person you work for); not_possible (message says why; leave it unwired and tell them). success false with 'No request with this requestId' means the id is wrong or belongs to another organisation.
name: get_request_status
